title: Smothered Mate
concept: A smothered mate is checkmate by a lone knight when the enemy king is completely boxed in by its own pieces and has nowhere to go.
tip: Look for an enemy king surrounded by its own pieces. A knight check on the right square can be mate.

feedback.correct: Checkmate! The king was smothered by its own army and the knight finished it.
feedback.hint: The king cannot move — its own pieces block every square. Where can your knight check it?
feedback.reveal: Trap the king with its own pieces, then deliver the knight check it cannot escape or block.
